description: We’re Grade 10 students who love space, coding, and design. We want to bring our skills together, share ideas, and create projects that explore real challenges in space.
summary:
Opportunity Rover’s Operation is an interactive storytelling game developed using Roblox Studio. Inspired by NASA’s Opportunity Rover mission, the game allows players to take the role of the rover and explore selected locations on Mars while learning about its real journey and scientific discoveries.

Players can interact with important discoveries, such as the Hematite Blueberries, to unlock scientific information and collect it in an in-game Information section.

Our project addresses the challenge “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” by bringing the story of a retired Mars rover back to life through gameplay. Instead of simply presenting information, we turn the rover’s exploration history into an interactive experience.

We hope this project will make space exploration more accessible, preserve the story of Opportunity Rover, and inspire more people, especially students, to become interested in science.
details:
Project Name: OPPORTUNITY ROVER’S OPERATION

OPPORTUNITY ROVER’S OPERATION is a storytelling game developed on Roblox Studio. The project is based on NASA’s Opportunity Rover mission and aims to make space exploration and scientific discoveries more accessible through an interactive gaming experience.

In the game, players take the role of Opportunity Rover and explore different locations on Mars, following selected events and discoveries from its real mission. Players can interact with important discoveries, such as the Hematite Blueberries, to receive scientific information. The information is then saved in an Information section, allowing players to review what they have learned.

We used information from NASA as the main reference for the rover’s history, exploration sites, and scientific discoveries. We applied this information to the game’s map, models, missions, and educational content.

The main development tool was Roblox Studio, which we used to build the environment, create models, and develop the game systems and user interface.

Our project aims to encourage people, especially students and those who are not familiar with space science, to become more interested in Mars exploration through gameplay rather than simply reading information.

Our creative approach is to combine real space exploration history with interactive storytelling. However, the game does not recreate the entire mission exactly. We selected some of the most interesting and well-known events and discoveries to make the experience more concise and suitable for our development time and resources.
